planSteps.description: Navigate to / and wait for the login page to load
Open the 'Seleccione una empresa' dropdown and click the option 'Admagro'
Leave Usuario and Contraseña empty and click the 'Ingresar' button
Validation messages 'The username is required' and 'The password is required' are visible under the respective fields
The browser URL path remains / and the user is not redirected to /home
